newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb board okays Carpenter as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb board okays Carpenter as CEO.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said Thursday its board approved a leadership transition plan under which William Carpenter, current president and chief operating officer, will become chief executive officer January 1.
William Waltrip, now the company's chairman and chief executive officer, will continue as chairman.

Waltrip took over as interim chairman and CEO in December 1995 after the retirement of then-chief executive Daniel Gill amid investor ire over disappointing forecasts for the company. Gill at the time said his retirement came from "personal planning."
Carpenter joined Bausch & Lomb in 1995 as executive vice president and global business manager-eyewear.
He was named president and chief operating officer after Gill retired and had been widely expected to move up to the CEO spot.
